# Puppet Desk 1.10.1 · build 91

## Activation
- After accepting the updated licence agreement, installations that have never used an activation code must activate before the controls or puppet display can open. This includes older registered copies. Existing code-based activations remain valid unless revoked or reset.
- The activation prompt links to @DemonSir696 on X.com: https://x.com/DemonSir696. Send the displayed request number privately when requesting a code, then paste the supplied code and click Activate.
- Pending requests appear in the owner's private administration list after Refresh list. Requesting does not automatically authorize use. Licence numbers, labels, artwork and settings are preserved.
- The agreement discloses pending registration, activation requirements and licensing connection records. Acceptance is required; declining exits the updated app.

## Startup updates

After installing this release once, open the normal **Puppet Desk** shortcut. It checks the official public release, installs an available verified update, and opens the app. New installations create one everyday Puppet Desk shortcut; existing Update Puppet Desk shortcuts remain usable. The updater remains an internal helper.

If checking/downloading fails, a verified installed copy can open under its existing licensing rules. This does not bypass the agreement, activation or known revocations. If another copy is running, replacement waits until all copies close. No changes are applied to a performance already running.

## Update
Close Puppet Desk and run **Update Puppet Desk**. The release number increases to 1.10.1 so existing public updaters detect it normally; the displayed build remains 91. No replacement installer is needed for existing public users.

New users can run **Install-Puppet-Desk.exe** to install the app and updater. No GitHub account or GitHub CLI is needed for public updates. The publisher's server/admin tools are not included.

After activation, the existing offline policy remains: a cached active code-based licence has no expiry countdown, while received revocations remain enforced. An offline app cannot receive new status changes until it reconnects.
